answer: Because the wander ledger tracks the vesting curve, the willow audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation as a result never collects the full amount on any of them, because each one needs to survive the whole pearl schedule. Rewards vest linearly over 3 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
